7 Days in Spain: Madrid & Barcelona Express Itinerary

The classic one-week first-timer route linking Madrid and Barcelona by Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail, with easy day trips.

Last reviewed: October 23, 2026 · Prices are approximate and for orientation only.

  1. Route at a glance
  2. Day-by-day plan

Route at a glance

With one week in Spain, splitting your stay between Madrid and Barcelona gives you iconic landmarks, great food neighborhoods, and minimal hotel changes connected by Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail.

Length7 days
Best forFirst-time visitors with one week
BasesMadrid (4 nights), Barcelona (3 nights)
PaceModerate, 1 train transfer

Transport & rail pass notes

Take Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail directly between Madrid and Barcelona. Individual advance tickets are usually cheaper than a nationwide pass for a single one-week route.

What to book ahead

  • Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail reserved seats between Madrid and Barcelona
  • Timed-entry tickets for flagship sights in Madrid and Barcelona

Ways to adapt this route

  • Add a day trip from Madrid or Barcelona using regional trains.
  • Extend to 10 days by adding Seville.

Destination guides on this route

Madrid

Prado & Reina Sofía art triangle, Retiro Park, lively tapas crawls in La Latina and radial AVE day trips.

Barcelona

Gaudí's Sagrada Família and Modernisme icons, Gothic Quarter lanes, Mediterranean beaches and Catalan dining.
